title: SessionPayload
description: Data uploaded from the mobile app to the backend after one rehabilitation session. NEVER contains raw video or personally-identifiable keypoint images.

client_uuid.description: UUID v4 generated on-device. Idempotency key: backend ignores duplicate POSTs with the same uuid.

started_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the session began (device clock).

ended_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the session ended (device clock).

pose_model_ver.description: Semver of the on-device TFLite/BlazePose model bundle used.

overall_score.description: Aggregate form score for the whole session (0-100).

plan_id.description: Optional FK -> rehabilitation_plans.id in backend database.

exercises.description: One entry per distinct exercise performed. Order matches the plan prescription.

reps_done.description: Total successful reps across all sets.

avg_form_score.description: Mean form score across all reps (0-100).

max_rom_deg.description: Max range-of-motion achieved in any single rep (degrees).

reps.description: Per-rep telemetry. Empty array valid if reps_done = 0.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of this rep in milliseconds.

rom_deg.description: Range of motion achieved in this rep (degrees).

form_score.description: Form quality score for this rep (0-100). Penalised per form_rule violation.

errors.description: Error code ids that fired during this rep (see error_codes.md). Empty = perfect form.

confidence.description: Mean BlazePose detection confidence across all frames in this rep (0-1).
